offering_description.value: Cantaloupe sells cashless payment devices, self-checkout equipment, and management software to vending, micro-market, and other retail operators. It processes payments through its connected devices and provides cloud tools for inventory, restocking, reporting, and mobile ordering.

primary_products.value: Cashless card readers and telemetry devices; self-checkout kiosks; smart coolers; vending and micro-market management software; mobile ordering and point-of-sale software

customer_segment.value: B2B: Vending and micro-market operators, workplace foodservice providers, laundromat and amusement operators, stadium and hospitality operators

end_markets.value: Unattended retail; workplace foodservice; self-service laundry; amusement and entertainment; hospitality

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Processing cashless purchases at connected machines and checkout terminals; subscription: Cloud management tools, device connectivity, and bundled equipment plans; product sales: Card readers, self-checkout kiosks, smart coolers, and related equipment
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; product sales

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Turns machine, inventory, and sales data into operating tools for unattended retail operators; service provider: Processes and settles cashless payments for vending, micro-market, and venue operators; distributor: Supplies payment and self-checkout equipment to operators of vending machines and micro-markets

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Ireland

specialization.value: related lines: Cashless payments, connected vending equipment, self-checkout, retail management software, and venue ordering

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving independent operators and enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: Vending equipment suppliers and technology partners that integrate payment devices

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Payment card security standards and data privacy rules apply to payment processing and connected retail systems.
